mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the foreign parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House / ACRA / State registries / SAMR for domestic re-registration, depending on foreign parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a licensed notary in the country of origin; then obtain an Apostille from the competent national authority (e.g., Secretary of State or Ministry of Foreign Affairs) if the origin state is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; if the origin state is NOT an Apostille Convention member, the notarized document must instead undergo consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate having consular jurisdiction. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive alternative routes and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Current Corporate Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or corporate affairs commission of the foreign parent company's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize locally, then affix Hague Apostille for member states; for non-member states proceed only with consular legalization by the PRC Embassy/Consulate. The two methods are parallel alternatives; do not combine Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing incorporation of the WFOE and appointment of its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign investing company, authenticated by corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Locally notarized board resolution, then Hague Apostille by the member-state competent authority; for non-member states, notarize then submit for consular legalization to the PRC Embassy/Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive, never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the foreign parent company (charter, by-laws, or memorandum)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign parent company / notary in jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Apostille for Hague Convention member states; notarization plus consular legalization before the competent PRC consulate for non-member states. Do not chain both regimes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter / creditworthiness certificate issued to the WFOE project financing escrow account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas or cross-border bank maintaining the investor's corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank signatory authentication, notarization, then Apostille if in an Apostille member state; otherwise consular legalization at a PRC Embassy/Consulate. These two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and certified passport copies of all shareholders, directors, legal representative and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owners / notary public in each owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Individual declarations are notarized, then Apostilled for member states; non-member state originals are notarized and legalized by PRC consular post. The two authentication streams are parallel alternatives and must not be mixed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited Financial Statements of the foreign investor for the last two fiscal years
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent certified public accountant / audit firm of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Audit firm certification, notarization, then Apostille by competent authority for member states; for non-members, consular legalization by PRC embassy/consulate. Parallel route only; do not chain Apostille and consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any filing, the responsible AML/CFT partner must screen every proposed shareholder, director, senior manager, ultimate beneficial owner, legal representative, and authorized signatory against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, PRC foreign affairs and PBOC/SAFE denial and control lists, and the local SAMR regulatory disqualified-persons database. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any person identified as a politically exposed person (PEP), family member, or close associate; each such person must provide a source-of-wealth statement supported by documentation. Screening must be repeated at least every 90 days throughout the incorporation period and continuously monitored for transaction anomalies, negative news, and asset-freeze designations. Results must be documented in a compliance sign-off before name clearance and UBO filing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Registration System of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); accessible through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform and the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System for verification.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese company name must be composed in simplified Chinese characters in a four-tier structure: [administrative division] + [distinctive trade name] + [industry/operating characteristic] + [company form]. For a WFOE, the distinctive trade name may be a phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's name, but the pinyin must be spelled consistently with the registered Chinese name and must not be deceptive or likely to mislead the public. An English name may be elected and must be recorded in the Articles of Association and filed with SAMR; the English name must be a faithful representation of the registered Chinese name for customs, tax, bank, and foreign-exchange declarations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR rejects a name reservation, the applicant may within 60 days of receiving the written rejection notice submit an administrative reconsideration petition to the SAMR at the same administrative level or to the people's government at the corresponding level, relying on the Measures for the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration and the Administrative Reconsideration Law of the People's Republic of China. The petition must attach the rejection notice, the proposed four-tier name structure, passport or certificate of incorporation of the investor, and a legal argument explaining why the name is not prohibited or confusingly similar. The reviewing authority should issue a decision within 60 days, extendable by 30 days in complicated cases; if the applicant is still dissatisfied, administrative litigation may be filed with the People's Court within six months. During the appeal, no alternative name should be submitted to avoid conflict of applications.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an ISIC 4322 seawater desalination EPC company, a pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally rejected as the sole registered address. The construction qualification certificate requires a physical place of business with lease term at least one year, actual office facilities, and personnel present. Local tax authorities and larger banking institutions will decline invoice quota applications and enterprise bank account opening if the registered address is only a virtual mailbox, especially for a construction industry company with high invoice limits and project escrow rails. A government-supported free-trade-zone address may be accepted for the registered office at the initial stage, but the company must maintain an actual project office at the desalination site and satisfy substance inspections; a virtual office is therefore acceptable only as a supplementary correspondence address, not as the statutory registered address for licensing and tax purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Risk level: high, estimated 75% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the municipal SAMR or tax authorities within the first 18 months after registration for a construction and EPC entity. Compliance checklist: original lease agreement and property ownership certificate displayed; office signage consistent with registered name; staff present during business hours; chop company seal custody log; accounting books and vouchers available; invoice issuance equipment physically located on site; water, electricity, and property-management invoices confirming actual use; project site permits, safety records, and qualification certificates of registered construction personnel; attendance and social insurance records for employees. A failed inspection can lead to removal from the address, cancellation of tax identification status, and suspension of the construction qualification.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 10, 23, 26, 30, 32, 37, 45, 46, 47, 49, 50 and 51; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 6, 12 and 28; Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List); Regulations on the Administration of Registration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Market Registration Supervision Division of the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration (MSA), under the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), through the National Enterprise Integrated Registration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Company Establishment Registration Application Package (Company Establishment Registration Application Form, Articles of Association, share subscription statement, and investor qualification documents).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital is imposed by the PRC Company Law for a WFOE LLC engaged in desalination EPC works; the shareholders freely determine the registered capital in the Articles of Association, and capital may be paid in installments within five years as agreed. No escrow or blocked capital account is mandated by Chinese company law for this industry, except that any project financing escrow account required by lenders or SWIFT project payment rails must be opened under a separately executed escrow agreement with a qualified commercial bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: MEETING of the Board of Directors of [Company Name], a proposed wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, duly convened on [Date] at the registered office address, with all directors attending in person and constituting a valid quorum. The legal representative designated in the Articles of Association chaired the meeting and recorded the minutes. RESOLVED: 1. Share Capital Subscription. That the registered capital of the Company is set at [CNY amount] divided into [number] ordinary shares with no par value, subscribed by the sole foreign shareholder in accordance with the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Law. The Board acknowledges that the capital contribution may be paid in cash or lawful contributed assets, and that payment may be made in installments over a maximum period of five years or as agreed in writing; any payment received shall be recorded in the capital contribution register and certified by an accounting firm if required. 2. Banking Authorization. That [Bank Name], [Branch Address], is selected as the Company principal settlement bank, and the Company shall open a basic deposit account, a foreign currency capital account, and any project financing escrow account required for the seawater desalination project. That the General Manager and Financial Officer are jointly authorized to sign account applications, endorse negotiable instruments, execute funds transfers, set up online banking tokens, and manage the escrow account in compliance with the project financing agreement. 3. Registered Office Adoption. That the registered office located at [Address] is adopted as the legal seat and statutory mailing address of the Company, and that the lease, property ownership certificate, and public safety records related to that address are accepted. That all statutory books, the corporate seal, tax registration documents, and corporate records shall be maintained at the registered office, and any change of registered office shall be effective only after board approval and filing with the competent MSA. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. That [Name] is appointed as Executive Director and Legal Representative; [Name] is appointed as General Manager; [Name] is appointed as Supervisor; and [Name] is appointed as Financial Officer, each to serve until removal by the shareholder or resignation. The Legal Representative is authorized to execute incorporation filings, sign contracts, open bank accounts, and represent the Company before government authorities. The Supervisor has independent supervisory power over financial records, related-party transactions, director conduct, and use of the Company seal. The Financial Officer is charged with maintaining complete accounting books and filing all tax declarations. RESOLVED FURTHER: that all officers are directed to proceed with registration, seal engraving, tax and social insurance registration, foreign exchange filing, environmental, fire, and construction licensing, and any other action necessary to make the Company operational. This resolution shall be binding on the Company and its successors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name pre-approval and Foreign Investment Negative List screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration (MSA) service hall or SAMR National Enterprise Integrated Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare a complete due-diligence file for the foreign investor and define the proposed business scope using the permitted standard description for seawater desalination EPC works. Submit an enterprise name reservation application through the SAMR integrated portal, including the company type, the proposed Romanized company name, and the verified ISIC 4322 construction and installation scope. The MSA officer screens the name for duplication and prohibited characters, and confirms that the project falls outside the Foreign Investment Negative List or, if listed, that the required competent authority approval has been obtained. Because desalination EPC is a permitted item under current negative-list rules, no additional investment approval is required; however, if the name includes the term China or a national designation, the SAMR final-level review must be arranged. Any document in a foreign language must be accompanied by an official translation into Chinese.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor identity documentation and certificate of incorporation
Power of attorney appointing the application agent
Proposed Articles of Association draft
Proposed registered address certificate
Business scope description mapping to ISIC 4322
Negative-list compliance memorandum
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is refused for duplication or restrictions, submit three alternative names and remove any prohibited national-level designation. If the negative-list screening is ambiguous, obtain a written clarification from the local commerce authority or the National Development and Reform Commission and re-present the application within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, legalization or apostille, and certified translation of investor documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Accredited notary public office, Ministry of Foreign Affairs or judicial authorities with apostille or legalization powers, and certified translation agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign shareholder must execute a board or shareholder resolution authorizing the establishment of the WFOE and appointing the local application agent. The certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, registered seat certificate, and identity documents must be authenticated by the competent authority of the investor jurisdiction, then legalized by the Chinese consulate or apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention, and finally submitted to a qualified notary office in China for confirmation of signatures. The notary office will examine the legal capacity of the shareholder, verify the seal and signature, and issue the notarial certificate. Certified translators must then prepare the Chinese translation of the foreign documents for filing with the MSA. The complete notarized dossier remains valid for the establishment registration filing and may also be used for banking and construction licensing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of foreign investor
Board or shareholder resolution authorizing WFOE establishment
Certificate of good standing issued within ninety days
Copy of passport or corporate identity document of signatories
Apostille certificate or consular legalization
Official Chinese translation of all foreign-language documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or consulate rejects the documents because of signature discrepancies, obtain a corrected corporate statement and a refreshed resolution. If the apostille process exceeds the deadline, request an expedited service from the relevant competent authority and file a written explanation with the MSA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of establishment registration and issuance of business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Market Supervision Administration (MSA) / SAMR National Enterprise Integrated Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name reservation, complete and sign the Company Establishment Registration Application Form, the final Articles of Association, the share subscription declaration, and the appointment document for the legal representative and supervisor. Submit the electronic application through the SAMR portal or physically at the municipal service hall, together with the notarized foreign investor documents, registered office lease, property ownership certificate, and identity documents of the officers. The MSA will review the entity name, registered capital, business scope, article consistency, and the legality of the statutory organs. Once satisfied, the MSA records the company in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and issues the business license with the unified social credit code, which functions as the establishment certificate, tax registration code, and statistical code. The license issuance must be verified by the applicant, and any discrepancy in the registered scope must be corrected immediately.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Notarized Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder
Share subscription statement and capital contribution schedule
Notarized and apostilled investor documents and translations
Power of attorney and agent identity
Registered office lease contract and property ownership certificate
Identity documents of the legal representative, executive director, manager and supervisor
Original name reservation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MSA issues a rectification notice, correct each non-conforming article or scope phrase and resubmit within fifteen working days. If the electronic system blocks the application, request a manual counter review at the same MSA and provide a written justification referencing the Foreign Investment Law and Company Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate seal engraving and Public Security Bureau filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving service provider and local Public Security Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after issuance of the business license, the legal representative or authorized agent must select an engraving company recognized by the local Public Security Bureau, presenting the original business license, the unified social credit code certificate, the legal representative identity document, and the authorization letter. The engraving company will produce the company seal, the contract seal, the finance seal, the invoice seal, and the legal representative seal, and shall submit the seal impressions to the Public Security Bureau for electronic filing. Seal use rules must be established by a board resolution, and the company must maintain a seal register recording each use. If bank accounts, tax invoices, or project contracts require a physical seal, the process will be completed after this filing.
required_dossiers: Original business license with unified social credit code
Legal representative identity document
Power of attorney for seal application
Certificate of registered address
Company seal specification declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Public Security Bureau delays seal filing because of address or legal representative mismatch, obtain a corrected business license from the MSA and resubmit the seal application. If a seal engraving service rejects the request, apply to a different approved vendor and file a complaint with the local public security administrative unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, social insurance registration, and foreign exchange filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local State Taxation Administration (STA) tax office, Municipal Social Insurance and Housing Fund Centers, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)-designated bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days after obtaining the business license, the financial officer must complete the information confirmation at the local tax office and configure the electronic tax declaration system, the payroll administration, and the invoice quota. The company must submit the business license, uniform social credit code certificate, bank account link, articles, and the legal representative identity to the tax bureau, and then register all employees with the social insurance center and housing fund provider. For inbound equity capital, the company must open a capital account at a qualified bank that is authorized by SAFE, file the foreign direct investment registration information, and keep the foreign exchange capital transfer records. Project financing escrow accounts used for SWIFT wire settlement require a separate bank confirmation and the same SAFE reporting if foreign exchange is involved.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code certificate
Articles of Association
Bank account certificate or basic deposit account opening notice
Legal representative and financial officer identity documents
Employee payroll list and labor contracts
Foreign exchange registration application form and shareholder subscription evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax registration information is queried or suspended, attend the tax office in person with the original business license and accounting policy statement, and apply for manual clearing of the record. If the foreign exchange filing fails, provide the bank with the notarized share subscription statement and execute a new registration through SAFE digital platform.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental impact assessment, fire certification, and construction qualification licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, Local Fire and Rescue Department, and Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau (MOHURD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before construction or operation begins for the physical desalination plant, engage a certified EIA consultant to classify the project and prepare the required Full Environmental Impact Report, Environmental Impact Form, or Registration Form under the MEE Classification List. Submit the EIA application to the competent ecology and environment bureau, including the process description for thermal or membrane desalination, intake and discharge points, brine concentration, anti-scalant chemistry, and construction-phase emissions. Simultaneously, file the fire protection design specification with the local fire department and complete the fire safety facility acceptance inspection before commissioning. The desalination EPC contractor must obtain the MOHURD construction enterprise qualification and, if the site uses pressure vessels or hoisting equipment, obtain relevant special equipment installation permits and registration certificates. The authority will inspect the site for structural load compliance, environmental mitigation measures, and fire escape routes before issuing the final construction or operation approval.
required_dossiers: EIA application form and project feasibility report
EIA consultant qualification certificate
Fire protection design documents
Construction enterprise qualification certificate
Special equipment installation permit
Structural loading and foundation inspection report
Sea area use certificate or resource administration approval
Occupational health and safety plan
Emergency response and spill prevention plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA report is returned for supplemental information, complete the supplementary public participation and impact prediction analyses within sixty days. If the fire review is suspended, rectify the fire separation distances and hydrant coverage, obtain a revised fire protection certificate, and resubmit the construction documents for approval.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau (MOHURD), Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE), Ministry of Natural Resources for sea area use, and local Fire and Rescue Department; construction contractor qualifications are administered by MOHURD.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Project Construction Permit and Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate for Seawater Desalination / Water Treatment Facilities, together with Sea Area Use Right Certificate and Special Equipment Installation Certification where pressure vessels, cranes, or elevated tanks are involved.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) via the local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 1 Full Environmental Impact Report for seawater desalination plants with a design capacity above 200,000 cubic meters per day or high saline concentrate discharge; Category 2 Environmental Impact Form for smaller plants with limited discharge; Environmental Registration for pilot demonstration projects with negligible brine and wastewater emissions. The competent authority must issue an EIA approval comment or registration notice before construction commences.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Brine and wastewater discharge must comply with Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1998: pH 6-9, total suspended solids 100 mg/L, COD 300 mg/L, BOD5 150 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen 25 mg/L as applicable; residual chlorine at the outlet shall not exceed 0.1 mg/L after dechlorination; thermal discharge temperature rise at the mixing zone boundary shall not exceed 3 degrees Celsius above ambient sea temperature; construction-phase fugitive dust shall not exceed 1.0 mg/m3 and VOC emissions shall be controlled with abatement systems to meet GB 16297-1996; hazardous waste such as discarded membranes, rejected cartridges, antifouling chemicals, and spent lubricating oil must be stored per GB 18597-2023, transported using hazardous waste manifests, and disposed of at licensed facilities within six months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification in the form of fire protection design review and fire facilities completion acceptance by the local Fire and Rescue Department; structural load inspection certificate from a qualified engineering inspector for all buildings, seawater intake structures, and pipe supports; workplace safety clearance by the Emergency Management Bureau covering occupational hazard evaluation, chemical and pressure equipment registration, confined-space entry protocols, electrical safety inspection, and emergency rescue facilities. Any underground civil defense facility, if incorporated into the plant, requires a concurrence certificate from the local civil defense / people air defense authority before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), acting through provincial and municipal tax service bureaus; primary online portal is the National Electronic Tax Service Platform (New Electronic Tax Service Platform), supplemented by the VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform for invoice verification and export tax refund filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the newly established Chinese WFOE, the TIN/VAT registration procedure is: (1) File for market entity registration with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the one-window enterprise registration system; the foreign investor must provide notarised and legalised incorporation documents, the legal representative's identity proof, articles of association, and business-scope description covering ISIC 4322 desalination EPC works. No minimum registered capital is required. (2) SAMR issues a business license with an 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is automatically transmitted to the tax authority under the multi-license integration regime; the USCC is simultaneously the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration number for the WFOE. (3) Activate the tax registration through the electronic tax service platform, complete real-name authentication of the legal representative and financial officer, and file the financial accounting system and tax-filing responsible person. (4) If expected annual VAT taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000, apply for general VAT taxpayer status; otherwise the entity remains a small-scale VAT taxpayer until the statutory threshold is met. (5) Apply for invoice quotas and activate fully digitalised electronic invoice issuance. A pure non-resident foreign enterprise without a permanent establishment in China does not obtain a Chinese VAT registration; its Chinese counterparty or payer performs statutory withholding where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (China does not provide a check-the-box or pass-through classification election). The WFOE is automatically a Chinese resident enterprise taxed at entity level at 25% Enterprise Income Tax on worldwide taxable income. The only relevant VAT election is between small-scale taxpayer status and general VAT taxpayer status, with general status being mandatory once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000 or if the WFOE needs to issue VAT special invoices to its customers.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 annual VAT taxable sales for compulsory general VAT taxpayer registration; no economic-turnover threshold exists for basic VAT registration because the WFOE becomes a VAT taxpayer automatically upon market entity registration. Small-scale taxpayers may be temporarily exempt from VAT on monthly sales up to RMB 100,000 or quarterly sales up to RMB 300,000, subject to applicable national policy.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a nationwide fully digitalised electronic invoice (FDEI / all-electric invoice) system on the National Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform. Taxpayers issue invoices in near real time through the electronic tax platform; the tax authority applies automated tax-control validation, digital stamping, invoice-number verification, and real-time clearance/risk screening. Traditional VAT special invoices are issued using tax-control UKey equipment and must be uploaded to the VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform; buyers must complete invoice verification/confirmation within 360 days from issuance to claim input VAT credits. Anti-fraud controls include encrypted QR codes, national invoice numbers, digital fiscal stamps, invoice-quota management, and automated reconciliation between invoicing data, VAT returns, and customs declaration data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of tangible goods from mainland China qualifies for zero-rating (VAT exemption with input-VAT refund/rebate) when the exporter is a VAT general taxpayer, the goods are actually declared to and cleared by Chinese Customs for export, title and risk transfer to the overseas buyer, and export proceeds are received through a bank in accordance with State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) rules. For an offshore seawater desalination EPC contract, cross-border services and exported equipment and materials may be zero-rated only where the services are provided to a non-resident recipient and the relevant service is performed outside mainland China; services consumed or performed inside China remain taxable at the applicable rate (9% for construction services and 13% for goods, as applicable). The WFOE must maintain a valid EPC contract, overseas end-user evidence, customs declarations, logistics documents, export invoices, payment matching records, and SAFE foreign-exchange receipts to substantiate the zero-rate claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration prepared through the China International Trade Single Window for the exported desalination equipment and materials
Commercial invoice issued by the WFOE to the overseas purchaser
Bill of Lading for sea freight or air waybill / multimodal transport document evidencing physical departure from mainland China
Export contract or EPC works contract with the overseas project company
Foreign-exchange receipt voucher (bank inward remittance advice or cross-border receipt and payment declaration) issued by a SAFE-designated bank evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The tax authority performs automated cross-matching of customs export declarations, export invoices, logistics documents, VAT tax returns, and bank foreign-exchange receipts. Zero-rating is disallowed if the tax authority finds no genuine export, no overseas qualifying recipient, incomplete documentation, or failure to receive export proceeds within the applicable foreign-exchange/tax-rebate deadlines; the entity is then required to pay VAT at the standard rate plus late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day. Under the Tax Collection Administration Law, fraudulent export tax refunds or false zero-rating declarations can trigger recovery of the entire refunded amount and an administrative penalty of 50% to 5 times the tax evaded or refunded, and serious cases may be referred for criminal liability for tax-refund fraud. Export tax refund claims are due tax-year based under the statutory export tax refund management regime; failing to secure timely foreign-exchange evidence can cause retrospective clawback of input VAT already refunded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC), with delegated regulatory execution by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime with RMB current-account convertibility and capital-account convertibility subject to administrative control. Under the Foreign Exchange Control Regulations (1996, revised 2008) and the Measures for Administration of Foreign Exchange in Direct Investment, a WFOE is treated as a resident enterprise after incorporation. Inbound equity capital injection from the foreign parent is a capital-account transaction requiring SAFE registration and approval; the funds must enter a designated FDI capital account and, once verified, can be converted to RMB for permitted business use under the negative-list system. Current-account receipts, including revenue from the desalination EPC works, are freely convertible but must be received into a domestic foreign-exchange account and verified through the As-One goods-trade monitoring system. Profit remittance to the overseas parent is classified as a current-account item but requires an audited annual financial statement, corporate income tax final settlement proof, and a board resolution declaring dividends. There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds in the current policy, but all export receipts must be repatriated to China within the statutory verification cycle. Capital-account outflows, such as repayment of foreign shareholder loans, require additional SAFE registration and must be matched to genuine project cash flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE foreign exchange settlement policy, there is no mandated conversion ratio for export foreign-currency receipts; the statutory obligation is repatriation and verification. Export proceeds from goods trade must be received into a domestic designated foreign-exchange account within 180 days from the date of Customs export declaration (unless a longer term is pre-registered with SAFE). Once received, the enterprise may retain the foreign currency or sell it to a domestic bank at the market rate. For desalination EPC equipment exports and related services, the underlying contract and Customs declarations must be uploaded to the As-One system for verification; non-repatriation or late repatriation triggers corrective penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (FDI Capital Escrow)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operating Currency Account plus Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Non-bank fintech EMI providers (e.g., Airwallex, Currenxie, Mercury) are not licensed by PBOC or SAFE as domestic banks or deposit-taking institutions and are legally barred from servicing capital-account transactions, inward FDI registration, or project escrow accounts for a mainland Chinese WFOE. They cannot issue accounts with SAFE designations or accept SWIFT MT103 payments designated as FDI equity injections. Their permissible role is limited to auxiliary trade facilitation for cross-border e-commerce or as payment gateway providers, which is irrelevant to a desalination EPC construction entity. The mandatory account rail for this WFOE is a domestically licensed bank connected to the SAFE cross-border payment reporting network.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the opening of the FDI capital account and the operational RMB/foreign-currency accounts, at least one authorised signatory with a valid verifiable identity must physically appear at the bank branch in mainland China to complete the initial KYC interview. If the statutory legal representative is an offshore individual, he or she may either attend in person or appoint, by a notarised and legalised power of attorney, a resident manager who attends the branch; the bank will additionally conduct a live video interview with the legal representative. A purely remote or consular proxy opening without any face-to-face contact is not accepted under PBOC anti-money laundering regulations, and the bank will request original corporate documents and the company seal for verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque UBO chain through offshore holding entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide an organisation chart of every shareholder, a certified register of members for each holding layer, notarised passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, FATCA/CRS self-certification forms, a sworn source-of-wealth statement, and recent bank references from the parent company's home bank to prove the identity and legitimacy of the owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of capital injection from third-party unrelated lender or high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit audited financial statements of the foreign parent for the last three years, the board resolution approving the equity injection, any underlying loan agreement if the funds are borrowed, bank statements tracing the funds from source to remittance, and a legal opinion from a qualified counsel confirming that the lending entity is not sanction-listed and that the funds do not originate from proceeds of crime.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between declared EPC contract and actual payment flows (e.g., mismatched amounts, invoice values, or payment routing)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the full signed EPC subcontracts, milestone-based progress payment certificates, proforma and commercial invoices, Customs export/import declarations, shipping bills and bills of lading, marine insurance certificates, and an independent engineer's valuation report that maps every cash flow to a specific construction milestone.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concern over the genuine operating purpose of the desalination plant and possible infrastructure asset stripping
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the project financing term sheet, the concession or operation agreement with the local municipal government, the statutory construction licence, environmental impact assessment approval, the geological and water-source survey report, and a comprehensive project budget audit confirming that the WFOE is a genuine operating company with committed future maintenance and operational cash flows.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the offshore parent to the WFOE's dedicated FDI capital account at a SAFE-designated domestic branch. The wire instruction must cite the SAFE FDI Registration Certificate number and the purpose code 'FDI equity investment' (use the standard code assigned during registration). Upon receipt, the bank reports the transaction to the SAFE cross-border payment reporting system; the company then obtains a capital verification report from a licensed Chinese CPA within six months of the contribution. RMB conversion is executed in tranches under the 'payment after verification' regime, meaning the bank inspects each disbursement's underlying genuine documents (EPC contract, supplier invoices, payroll, lease agreements) before converting. Proceeds cannot be used on the restricted negative-list activities such as share investment, real estate speculation, or repayment of RMB loans, except as separately approved.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For equipment and services imported for the desalination plant, the company will use SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for prepayments and open-account settlements, Commercial L/C (sight or usance) for high-value specialised equipment such as reverse-osmosis membranes, pumps and thermal evaporators, and documentary collections (D/P and D/A) for established suppliers. Every outbound payment must match an import Customs declaration and an invoice in the SAFE goods-trade monitoring system; services payments require a Service Trade Foreign Exchange Statement and underlying contract. The bank will assign an international payments purpose code and perform anti-money laundering screening against sanctions lists for every beneficiary bank and counterparty.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable RMB/foreign-currency forward contracts (forward settlement and sale) with genuine and documented current-account trade exposure
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for medium- and long-term project financing in foreign currency
Plain vanilla FX options used exclusively as hedge instruments, not for speculative position taking
FX swap transactions for short-term liquidity management between RMB and the project's invoicing currencies (USD or EUR)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible onshore; only deliverable derivatives from licensed domestic banks may be executed under SAFE trade-background verification

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (including Foreign Investment Annual Information Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System; data is shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) in accordance with the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each year, reporting on the immediately preceding calendar year (a newly incorporated enterprise commences its first report from the following year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late non-filing immediately places the company on the Operating Abnormal List; remaining on that list without remedy for three consecutive years triggers placement on the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, disqualifying the legal representative and responsible officers from acting as directors/supervisors/executives for up to three years and leading to public credit blacklisting; persistent failure may ultimately result in administrative revocation of the business license. Any false or misleading content in the annual report attracts an administrative fine of RMB 10,000-RMB 100,000 (approx. USD 1,400-USD 14,000) under the Enterprise Information Publicity Regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return (Annual CIT Reconciliation and Payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) local competent tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following the fiscal year where the fiscal year is the calendar year; within five months after the end of the accounting year for a non-calendar fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to a correction order and a fine of up to RMB 2,000 (approx. USD 280), or RMB 2,000-RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 280-USD 1,400) in aggravated circumstances; late payment additionally accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax from the day after the statutory due date until payment in full. Tax understatement or evasion may attract a penalty of 0.5 to 5 times the amount of tax understated, plus interest, and, in extreme cases, property preservation measures and criminal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Direct Investment Stock Equity Information Report (FDI Annual Equity / UBO-Related Foreign Exchange Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the capital-project information system; supervised by the local SAFE branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each year, based on the prior year-end shareholding and ownership structure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing places the enterprise on SAFE's abnormal/restricted listing, causing banks to suspend outward remittances of profits, dividends, repatriation of capital on reduction, and equity transfer proceeds until the report is remedied; SAFE may also issue a warning and impose a fine of up to RMB 50,000 (approx. USD 7,000) for failure to comply with foreign-exchange data reporting requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Independent Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Audit Report on Annual Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: All shareholders (shareholders' meeting); the signed audit report is also made available to SAMR, STA, SAFE and other regulators as part of annual filings and credit-information checks
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, in any event no later than within four months after the fiscal year-end for the shareholding confirmation and by the May 31 CIT final settlement deadline (i.e., before completion of the annual tax reconciliation when tax filing relies on audited statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain the legally required audit is a breach of the PRC Company Law and Foreign Investment Law; the company may be treated as non-compliant in SAMR annual-report reviews and SAFE filings, tax authorities may disregard the unaudited financial statements for tax compliance, and administrative warnings/fines may be imposed on the company and directly responsible personnel under applicable regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Contribution Base Declaration (Annual Wage Base Refresh)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau (HRSS) or local tax authority under the provincial social-insurance collection model
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Provincially variable, typically between April and July of each year for the next contribution-base window; exact dates are fixed by each provincial-level HRSS/tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under-declaration or non-declaration of the contribution base: daily late surcharge of 0.05% on the social-insurance arrears from the due date until paid; if the employer still refuses to pay after a compliance order, the relevant authority may impose an administrative fine of one to three times the amount of arrears and may seize bank funds/credits, with public credit discipline records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statistical Survey Report (Enterprise Operations, Employees and Wages)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Statistics Bureau under the National Bureau of Statistics
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally due between January 1 and March 20 (extended in some provinces to April 30) for the preceding calendar year, as notified by the local statistics bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, refused or false statistical reporting: the local statistics bureau orders correction, issues a warning and may impose a fine of up to RMB 50,000 (approx. USD 7,000) on the enterprise, with aggravated cases (including material obstruction or falsity) subject to fines up to RMB 200,000 (approx. USD 28,000) and direct personal fines on the responsible staff.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Customs Registered Enterprise Report (if the WFOE holds an importer/exporter registration for equipment or consumables)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Administration of Customs of China (GACC) via the China International Trade Single Window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each year for customs-registered enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the annual customs report by June 30 leads to the enterprise being downgraded to the 'General Credit' or 'Discredited' compliance level, resulting in mandatory inspection of inbound/outbound cargo, loss of AEO/inward-processing facilitation, possible refusal of customs declaration privileges, and a fine of up to RMB 50,000 (approx. USD 7,000) for violation of customs supervision-reporting obligations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC Company Law (revised 2023) categorically requires every limited liability company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), to have its annual financial report audited by a certified public accountant firm practising in China; there is no exemption based on balance-sheet size, total revenue or headcount. Accordingly, the WFOE has a mandatory annual CPA audit regardless of quantitative thresholds. In addition, foreign-funded enterprises must produce audited statements in support of their annual FDI equity information registration and the annual enterprise credit report; enterprises undertaking ISIC 4322 construction/desalination works are also required to maintain project-completion audits under construction-industry accounting requirements when invoicing project-financing escrows. Quantitative triggers under local rules: none that exempt this entity; for statistical reference, the Ministry of Finance classification of 'small enterprises' (e.g., assets less than RMB 50 million, revenue less than RMB 10 million, headcount less than 300) simply allows use of the Simplified Small-Business Enterprise Accounting System, but does not remove the audit duty.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS / PRC GAAP), which are substantially converged with IFRS; qualifying micro-and-small enterprises may elect the 'Standards for Small Business Enterprises' (Small-Enterprise Accounting System), but a foreign-invested construction/EPC contractor normally applies full CAS to match project revenue recognition (ASC/IFRS-referencing parent reporting) and to satisfy bank escrow and tax authorities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Owner Information Administration Measures (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3 of 2024, effective 1 November 2024), the WFOE must identify and keep current the ultimate beneficial owners (natural persons who ultimately control the entity through capital, voting rights, or equivalent means), and must file any change via SAMR's National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System within 30 calendar days of the change. In addition, the annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (due January 1-June 30) serves as the annual UBO confirmation, requiring the enterprise to reconfirm/update beneficial-owner identification data as of the reporting date. On-site UBO records and all supporting identification documents must be maintained at the registered office and be available for inspection by PBOC, SAMR and tax authorities; failure to maintain or report beneficial-owner information is subject to correction orders and fines up to RMB 5,000 (approx. USD 700) for instrument-or-evasion violations, increasing in aggravated cases.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges/Mortgages (registered encumbrances, pledges and guarantees)
Minute Book (resolutions of shareholders, board of directors and legal representative decisions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 3,200 per annum depending on city tier (registered-address provision in a business park, local corporate-agency services and statutory correspondence handling).
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 9,000 per annum for a small-to-mid-size WFOE engaged in seawater-desalination EPC works, based on revenue, contract assets, project complexity and city-specific professional rates; excluding tax advisory and notarial costs.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A qualifying Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise may apply a reduced 15% rate under the High and New Technology Enterprise (HNTE) regime; the West China development tax incentive also provides a 15% rate until December 31, 2030; qualified R&D expenses may benefit from a 100% super-deduction (i.e., 200% of eligible R&D expenditure deducted); small and low-profit enterprises are taxed at reduced combined effective rates; desalination and public utility infrastructure projects may access accelerated depreciation and tax holiday eligibility under the encouraged industry catalogue, but there is no separate patent box regime for EPC desalination contractors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Enterprise Income Tax Annual Tax Return (A Type) - Form A100000 together with supporting schedules (A105000, A105080, A107012, A108000, and the annual related-party transaction report forms), filed through the State Taxation Administration administrative e-Filing portal (e-Tax) in China.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly provisional CIT prepayments during the tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The taxpayer must file and pay provisional enterprise income tax within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual returns and final settlement documents must be filed before May 31 immediately following the end of the calendar/fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification and filing status: legal entity name, Unified Social Credit Code, address, registered capital, legal representative, line of business, industry classification, and selected HNTE status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a WFOE, the taxpayer must mark itself as a resident enterprise with unlimited enterprise income tax liability on worldwide income. The industry code must map ISIC 4322 (construction of desalination plants) to the national tax industry classification, and the desalination construction qualification/license number must be recorded for consistency with the regulatory approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting revenue: operating revenue, revenue from construction contracts, other operating income, non-operating income, and fair-value gains as reconciled to audited financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must identify any revenue from an offshore parent or affiliated EPC subcontractor. If services are physically rendered outside China but are integral to construction in China, the China-sourced income character must be examined; a pure procurement or pass-through invoicing model will be recharacterized as a service or royalty and subjected to China withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs and deductions: direct project costs, subcontracting costs, procurement of desalination membranes, thermal evaporator equipment, construction labour, depreciation, amortisation, financing costs, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to non-resident related companies must be supported by valid contracts, benefit-test evidence, and contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation. Payments for membranes, pumps, control systems, engineering drawings, or process licenses must be split into goods, services, and intellectual-property elements; overstated payments create a permanent-difference add-back and trigger special tax adjustment interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation of accounting profit to taxable income: add-back of non-deductible expenses, deduction of tax-exempt income, and application of prior-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforwards are limited to five years generally, with ten years available for qualifying high-technology or technology-oriented enterprises. Intercompany charges for headquarters overhead, corporate guarantees, or home-office cost allocations are not automatically deductible; they must satisfy the arm's length standard and the substance requirement. Any amount treated as a hidden royalty or interest will need separate withholding tax treatment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income multiplied by the applicable enterprise income tax rate, special tax adjustment income, domestic credits, foreign income tax credits, and net tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-shelf WFOE with HNTE approval uses the 15% rate; otherwise the headline 25% rate applies. The return must not reduce taxable income by foreign withholding tax on deemed dividends or royalties except through the foreign tax credit schedules. If the WFOE is found to have no real commercial activity, the tax authority may reattribute profit to the non-resident shell and impose 10% withholding tax on China-sourced income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transactions disclosures: the annual related-party transaction reporting forms listing every transaction with non-resident and resident connected parties, including transaction type, country, amount, and transfer pricing method.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a desalination EPC WFOE, major disclosures include procurement from overseas affiliates, design and engineering fees, equipment rental, licensing of desalination technology, interest on shareholder loans, and management fees. Failure to attach the related-party forms or incomplete disclosure will expose the entity to automatic audit selection, penalty under the Tax Collection and Administration Law, and the authority to use deemed or estimated pricing for the entire project.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayments and final settlement: quarterly provisional tax paid, foreign tax credits utilised, additional tax due or refundable, and declaration of declared dividends during the tax year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Undistributed profits do not attract dividends withholding tax, but once the shareholders pass a dividend resolution and remit payment, the WFOE as withholding agent must calculate 10% statutory withholding tax or an applicable treaty-reduced rate and file a separate withholding tax declaration. Any shortfall in quarterly prepayment accrues late-payment surcharge from the statutory deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return or related-party schedules exposes the entity to a corrective order and a fine of up to RMB 2,000 under Article 62 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, increased to RMB 10,000 in serious cases; unpaid tax carries a surcharge of 0.05% per day (approximately 18.25% per annum). Intentional under-declaration or false deduction sufficient to evade more than RMB 50,000 of tax while exceeding 10% of the tax payable constitutes criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, with penalties including imprisonment of up to seven years and fines from one to five times the evaded amount.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on gross dividends paid by the Chinese resident WFOE to a non-resident parent or non-resident shareholder, subject to a lower treaty rate where the beneficial owner qualification is met; many Chinese double tax treaties reduce the dividend rate to 5% for corporate shareholders holding at least 25% of the capital of the WFOE, with some treaties allowing 0% or 15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The payer, as the withholding agent, should file the tax withholding declaration, identify the applicable DTA article, and apply the reduced rate at source. Non-resident shareholders must deliver a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by their home tax authority (with legalization/apostille where required), a duly completed Beneficial Owner Declaration, and evidence of the direct shareholding percentage and holding period. SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9 demands substantive business in the treaty jurisdiction and real control, not a conduit arrangement. If over-withheld, the non-resident may apply for a refund under Article 32 of the implementation measures within a statutory period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate is 10% for interest and 10% for royalties paid by a China-resident WFOE to non-residents; under Chinese DTAs interest is commonly reduced to 10% (with some treaties 5% or 7%), and royalties commonly to 10% or 7%, depending on intellectual property type and treaty. In an EPC context, royalties embedded in a packaged engineering and technology supply contract must be segregated and declared; interest paid on shareholder loans requires a real debt and compliance with thin capitalization rules, otherwise recharacterization as a hidden dividend occurs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where related-party tangible asset transactions exceed RMB 100 million, intangible asset or financial asset related-party transactions exceed RMB 100 million, or other related-party transactions exceed RMB 40 million in the preceding fiscal year; Master File is statutory where the Chinese entity's total related-party transactions reach RMB 1 billion, or where the multinational group fails the relevant turnover or documentation threshold under SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Other reasonable methods approved by the State Taxation Administration where a traditional method cannot reliably reflect the arm's length result
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China has not enacted the Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations, but the OECD-endorsed substance concept is embedded in Chinese tax law through the beneficial ownership doctrine, the non-resident treaty shopping rules, the general anti-avoidance rule under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, and the place of effective management analysis. Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) for the seawater desalination EPC entity include engineering design, procurement, mobilization of construction crews, site management, QA/QC supervision, and financing or risk management decisions; the WFOE must prove board meetings, employee headcount, cost origination, decision-making, and project contracts are actually performed in China, otherwise a temporary or deemed agency/PE can create non-resident corporate income tax exposure, treaty denial, and 10% withholding on recharacterized China-source income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Intentional False Filing in the Annual Corporate Income Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting the desalination project revenue, recording fictitious subcontractor invoices, inflating imported equipment costs from the non-resident related supplier, or using forged VAT-inclusive invoices to reduce taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law: recovery of the underpaid tax and late-payment surcharge plus a penalty of 50% to five times the evaded amount. Article 201 of the Criminal Law: criminal tax evasion liability for evaded tax above RMB 50,000 and more than 10% of the tax payable, leading to imprisonment of up to seven years, a fine, and public registration of serious dishonest tax conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the WFOE corporate veil where the directors or parent treat the entity as an alter ego, commingle funds, and use the corporate form to evade taxes. The legal representative, finance director, and beneficial owner may face joint civil liability, seizure of personal assets, travel bans and exit restriction, blacklisting under the serious tax violation publicity rules, disqualification from acting as a director, and criminal imprisonment where the director personally caused the false filing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: WHT Non-Compliance on Outbound Dividends, Interest, and Royalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and remitting dividends to a non-resident parent without withholding the statutory 10% WHT, paying interest or royalties under a related-party contract without documentary support, or claiming a DTA reduced rate without a Tax Residency Certificate and demonstrable beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 69 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law: withholding agent shall be ordered to recover the unrecovered tax and is liable for a penalty of 50% to three times the tax that was not withheld. Article 32 additionally imposes a 0.05% daily surcharge on the late tax payment. A false treaty-relief form may be treated as fraudulent tax avoidance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who individually orders or approves an unlawful outward remittance may be jointly and severally liable to restore the corporate funds and satisfy the withheld taxes; directors can be subject to exit-control penalties and a departure ban while the entity remains listed as a serious tax violator. If the unreported withholding is part of a scheme to conceal related-party profit, the director may be criminally charged as the person directly in charge of the tax evasion offence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Profit Shifting and Shell-Entity Substance Deficiency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the WFOE as a paper-thin pass-through for the desalination EPC while all profit is stripped through overpriced procurement, excessive management fees, engineered royalties, or shareholder loans; failing to prepare the Local File, Master File, and related-party transaction forms; not having real offices, personnel, or decision-making substance in China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may adjust taxable income under Articles 41 and 44 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and impose special tax adjustment interest at the Chinese benchmark lending rate plus five percentage points from the first day of the tax payment default. Failure to provide the required contemporaneous documentation permits the tax authority to use estimated assessment and to impose enforcement penalties under the Tax Collection and Administration Law, including upward adjustment, interest, and fines for non-compliance with documentation orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Chinese courts may pierce the corporate veil and hold the non-resident shareholder or controlling directors liable for unpaid corporate tax and project liabilities when the WFOE is only a shell and the foreign parent exercises complete economic control. The WFOE directors may face civil restitution, joint liability for the special adjustment, travel restrictions, and potential criminal prosecution for tax evasion as persons actually controlling the entity if deliberate profit stripping and documentation concealment are proven.
